abilities.behavior: Delayed branching ice fissures trace outward from both fists.
abilities.counterplay: Step across an unlit branch before the cracks activate.

abilities.behavior: Concentric freezing rings have a visibly unmarked wedge.
abilities.counterplay: Move through the rotating wedge instead of outrunning the ring.

abilities.behavior: Suspended ice lances fall in alternating rows.
abilities.counterplay: Stand between the highlighted rows; the next row warns separately.

phase_two.behavior: Ring gaps reverse; exposed crystal joints retain a long punish window.

abilities.behavior: A water-current anchor pulls along a single marked lane.
abilities.counterplay: Move perpendicular to the lane or destroy the exposed anchor.

abilities.behavior: Three vortices orbit and converge on fixed endpoints.
abilities.counterplay: Use the displayed safe current between vortices.

abilities.behavior: Submerged silhouettes predict staggered surface breaches.
abilities.counterplay: Leave the silhouettes; each breach locks its destination early.

phase_two.behavior: Two current anchors alternate; breaking either gives a recovery window.

abilities.behavior: A paw-marked straight charge locks direction before launching.
abilities.counterplay: Cross the paw trail or punish the stopped wolf from the flank.

abilities.behavior: Decoy wolves telegraph alternating pounces.
abilities.counterplay: Identify the solid shadow and leave its landing marker.

abilities.behavior: The wolf circles toward the last observed player footprint.
abilities.counterplay: Move away from the marked footprint before the final bite.

phase_two.behavior: A third charge can be feinted, with a distinct howl and longer final recovery.

abilities.behavior: A thrown axe follows a curved outbound and returning path.
abilities.counterplay: Dodge across the marked curve after its outbound pass.

abilities.behavior: Visible chains connect summoned anchors before tightening.
abilities.counterplay: Break a highlighted weak link or move outside its span.

abilities.behavior: Spectral rowers launch staggered rectangular surges.
abilities.counterplay: Use the missing-row gap; the rowers can be interrupted.

phase_two.behavior: Returning axe paths cross once; chain weak links remain attackable.

abilities.behavior: Placed spectral conductors connect with delayed lightning lines.
abilities.counterplay: Stand outside the drawn connections or break a conductor.

abilities.behavior: A thunderclap expands through an annulus, leaving the center safe.
abilities.counterplay: Choose the inner refuge or leave the outer edge during windup.

abilities.behavior: Parallel wind channels push toward lit strike zones.
abilities.counterplay: Move into an unlit channel before the push starts.

phase_two.behavior: Conductors gain one visible fork; grounded intervals open the boss.

abilities.behavior: Three mounted dashes follow a previewed triangular route.
abilities.counterplay: Leave the triangle edges and attack during the turn.

abilities.behavior: Arrow fans arrive from visible circling falcon markers.
abilities.counterplay: Face the announced fan gap and reposition between volleys.

abilities.behavior: A banner charges a limited offensive rally until interrupted.
abilities.counterplay: Break the banner during its long warning or dodge the rally lanes.

phase_two.behavior: Ride routes change after a banner signal; each banner exposes a flank.

abilities.behavior: A broad fan of individually visible tridents travels outward.
abilities.counterplay: Move through the announced fan gap rather than backing straight away.

abilities.behavior: Expanding bubbles burst only after their boundary fills.
abilities.counterplay: Exit the bubble boundary before it completes.

abilities.behavior: Floating mines illuminate a chain before detonation.
abilities.counterplay: Leave the indicated chain or interrupt its lit source mine.

phase_two.behavior: Pressure bubbles alternate with mines; escape corridors remain unmarked.

abilities.behavior: Root lines form a delayed lattice with open cells.
abilities.counterplay: Move into an unrooted cell before the roots close.

abilities.behavior: Lobbed pods sprout short-lived hazards at fixed landings.
abilities.counterplay: Leave the landing rings or destroy the dormant pod.

abilities.behavior: A high branch rotates around a visible near-trunk refuge.
abilities.counterplay: Use the inner refuge or pass behind the branch after its sweep.

phase_two.behavior: Seed pods bloom twice while the treant exposes its root heart.

abilities.behavior: The king announces a thrust, feint or guarded riposte with distinct stances.
abilities.counterplay: Sidestep the thrust; wait out the riposte stance before attacking.

abilities.behavior: Spectral knights charge only along heralded lanes.
abilities.counterplay: Move into the missing rank or interrupt its standard bearer.

abilities.behavior: Orbiting regalia shield marked directions while exposing another.
abilities.counterplay: Attack from the exposed direction or break a lit regalia piece.

phase_two.behavior: The duel adds a second announced feint; breaking regalia extends the opening.

abilities.behavior: Rune anchors draw a delayed circuit across the arena.
abilities.counterplay: Occupy an unconnected rune or interrupt the lit junction.

abilities.behavior: Runic projectiles preview one wall rebound before launch.
abilities.counterplay: Use the rebound preview instead of tracking the first line alone.

abilities.behavior: A polygonal hammer shock leaves safe lit rune pads.
abilities.counterplay: Reach a safe rune pad before the stamp lands.

phase_two.behavior: Rune circuits change sequence but reveal every connection before discharge.

abilities.behavior: A serpentine breath path tracks briefly then freezes its route.
abilities.counterplay: Cross behind the frozen ribbon before it ignites.

abilities.behavior: A dive follows a descending spiral with a central refuge.
abilities.counterplay: Use the center or an announced opening in the spiral.

abilities.behavior: Five jade orbs pulse in a visible color sequence.
abilities.counterplay: Move between the next-pulsing orbs; no class-specific action is required.

phase_two.behavior: Breath ends early to combine with a separate, clearly marked spiral dive.

abilities.behavior: Swelling bubbles burst into temporary poison pools.
abilities.counterplay: Leave the swelling circle or burst it early from range.

abilities.behavior: A slow cloud pursues one clearly marked target.
abilities.counterplay: Kite the cloud out of the group or interrupt its caster.

abilities.behavior: The queen swaps with a visibly charged decoy before a hex wave.
abilities.counterplay: Watch the charged decoy and leave its announced wave direction.

phase_two.behavior: Decoy swaps affect the queen, not players; hazards pair with longer warnings.

abilities.behavior: Water mirrors shield announced projectile directions only.
abilities.counterplay: Attack from the open flank or strike the exposed mirror core.

abilities.behavior: Jets activate alternating rows of a visible grid.
abilities.counterplay: Move into the next inactive row during the warning.

abilities.behavior: Tribute orbs travel toward a shield while broadcasting their paths.
abilities.counterplay: Intercept an orb safely or dodge the resulting announced pulse.

phase_two.behavior: Mirror openings alternate with pressure rows; tribute orbs shorten the shield.

abilities.behavior: Fixed-heading frontal sword cone, physical damage with ignition and knockback.
abilities.counterplay: Dodge behind the king or outside the warned cone.

abilities.behavior: Ground marks stay fixed; falling flame trails precede one area impact.
abilities.counterplay: Leave the marked circles before the impact.

abilities.behavior: Temporary non-terrain zones pulse damage after their warning.
abilities.counterplay: Step out of the zones; overlapping zones do not multiply one pulse.

phase_two.behavior: Cooldown 55 to 35 ticks; movement x1.25; extra meteor marks; eruption 4/80 to 7/120 damage/ticks.

abilities.behavior: Petal-shaped danger arcs open around a central safe lily.
abilities.counterplay: Move through the unlit petal before the arcs close.

abilities.behavior: The serpent previews a coiled route then traverses it.
abilities.counterplay: Cross the announced coil opening rather than following the head.

abilities.behavior: Reflected blooms copy a pulse after a separate warning.
abilities.counterplay: Leave the echo bloom before its delayed second pulse.

phase_two.behavior: Petal gaps rotate after each pulse; the serpent exposes its tail between patterns.

abilities.behavior: Sand spirits advance through previewed winding lanes.
abilities.counterplay: Cross into a lane without a procession marker.

abilities.behavior: Temporary spectral obelisks cast safe shadows before a sun pulse.
abilities.counterplay: Use the displayed shadow or interrupt an obelisk.

abilities.behavior: Burrowing silhouettes announce three successive eruptions.
abilities.counterplay: Keep moving out of each locked silhouette, not the whole arena.

phase_two.behavior: Sand lanes shift after an audible command; shadow refuges remain stable.

abilities.behavior: Temporary water-gate waves sweep through visible openings.
abilities.counterplay: Pass through an announced opening before the gate reaches you.

abilities.behavior: Javelins rise from marked riverbed spots in sequence.
abilities.counterplay: Leave the next numbered spot during its separate warning.

abilities.behavior: Small current anchors feed a central charge.
abilities.counterplay: Interrupt an anchor or use its unlit crossing before the surge.

phase_two.behavior: Currents rotate between calls; water gates retain broad announced openings.

abilities.behavior: Spectral grappling lines preview the corsair boarding route.
abilities.counterplay: Move away from the rope landing or punish the boarding recovery.

abilities.behavior: Side cannons light their barrels before firing straight lanes.
abilities.counterplay: Use gaps between barrels or interrupt the lit cannon.

abilities.behavior: Rolling bombs display individual fuses and fixed detonation circles.
abilities.counterplay: Kick or leave a bomb before its own fuse expires.

phase_two.behavior: Cannons alternate flanks and bombs retain visible fuses.

abilities.behavior: Seed pods draw triangular vine snares before tightening.
abilities.counterplay: Escape an open triangle edge or destroy a pod.

abilities.behavior: A straight tongue lash marks its line before a pull attempt.
abilities.counterplay: Sidestep the line or interrupt the exposed tongue tip.

abilities.behavior: Foliage shadows reveal a chosen landing before the leap.
abilities.counterplay: Leave the locked shadow, then attack during landing recovery.

phase_two.behavior: Pods grow paired vines; destroying a pod exposes a weak spot.

abilities.behavior: Temporary coral silhouettes form an advancing broken ring.
abilities.counterplay: Use its clearly unoccupied gate; no permanent coral blocks are placed.

abilities.behavior: A sonar sector repeats once with a separate warning.
abilities.counterplay: Dodge the first sector and its announced echo direction.

abilities.behavior: Slow urchins spread from previewed sockets.
abilities.counterplay: Move between sockets or destroy the slow urchin before contact.

phase_two.behavior: Reef echoes add one delayed rotation; coral gates always have a safe gap.

abilities.behavior: Golden plates preview a reflected sunlight path.
abilities.counterplay: Cross behind the announced reflection or interrupt the plate.

abilities.behavior: Dust lanes reveal a limited spectral stampede.
abilities.counterplay: Move into a clear lane instead of racing along the charge.

abilities.behavior: A charged kneel sends staggered ground lobes with inner refuges.
abilities.counterplay: Use an inner refuge or leave the next marked lobe.

phase_two.behavior: Reflected rays alternate with marked stampedes; kneeling creates recovery.

abilities.behavior: Shadows mark sequential falling rocks along canyon lanes.
abilities.counterplay: Leave the next shadow; each rock locks its landing.

abilities.behavior: Temporary cairns trace a delayed tether web.
abilities.counterplay: Break a lit cairn or stand outside connected segments.

abilities.behavior: The warlord previews a leap and a subsequent narrow shock line.
abilities.counterplay: Leave the landing circle, then sidestep the announced line.

phase_two.behavior: Rockfalls alternate ledges; broken cairns create longer punish windows.

abilities.behavior: Visible air paths offer lift before a low sweeping beam.
abilities.counterplay: Enter a safe updraft or move behind the announced sweep.

abilities.behavior: Feathers form a constellation then launch along drawn connections.
abilities.counterplay: Stand outside connections or interrupt a lit feather node.

abilities.behavior: A descending guardian shadow fixes its landing and wake.
abilities.counterplay: Leave the shadow and cross behind the trailing wake.

phase_two.behavior: Updraft paths alternate and feather volleys retain their telegraphed gaps.

abilities.behavior: Colored spore rings activate in a displayed sequence.
abilities.counterplay: Move into a ring that has just finished pulsing.

abilities.behavior: Seedlings feed a healing root pool while warning their growth area.
abilities.counterplay: Destroy a seedling to open a safe path and interrupt healing.

abilities.behavior: A slow inhalation draws spores inward before a directional release.
abilities.counterplay: Move out of the drawn release sector or interrupt the throat bloom.

phase_two.behavior: Spore colors change order; cleared root pools remain safe refuges.

abilities.behavior: Paired seams preview a spatial crossing and delayed rupture.
abilities.counterplay: Leave the connected seam or use the announced unlinked crossing.

abilities.behavior: Clearly bounded gravity wells charge before pulling.
abilities.counterplay: Exit the boundary or destroy its exposed focus.

abilities.behavior: An eclipse reveals a rotating unshaded corridor between beams.
abilities.counterplay: Follow the unshaded corridor during each announced rotation.

phase_two.behavior: Void seams change topology, with pair destinations always shown before activation.

abilities.behavior: Visible draining tethers connect charged vessels to the monarch.
abilities.counterplay: Break a vessel or move out of its announced line.

abilities.behavior: Blades orbit in staggered heights with a visible safe crossing.
abilities.counterplay: Use the crossing when its blade has just passed.

abilities.behavior: Spectral courtiers announce a shared life-drain channel.
abilities.counterplay: Interrupt a marked courtier or leave its limited channel sector.

phase_two.behavior: Blood tethers alternate with orbiting blades; broken tethers expose the monarch.

abilities.behavior: Eye lights announce a locked gaze beam, with an obvious shutter cue.
abilities.counterplay: Leave the beam line before the eye opens.

abilities.behavior: Sound rings display a harmonic safe band between pulses.
abilities.counterplay: Move into the lit safe band instead of crossing every wave.

abilities.behavior: Lantern nodes reveal delayed converging rays.
abilities.counterplay: Interrupt a lantern or stay outside its drawn ray intersection.

phase_two.behavior: Gaze patterns add an echo while harmonic safe zones alternate visibly.
